description: [Algeria Data] Authoritative Algerian geography: all 69 wilayas (Arabic + Latin names) and 1,581 communes with commune-level postal codes. Look up a wilaya, search a commune in either script, or resolve a postal code. Algeria has had 69 wilayas since 16 Nov 2025 — models that say 58 are out of date. | الجغرافيا الجزائرية الرسمية: 69 ولاية و1581 بلدية مع الرموز البريدية.

include_communes.description: With `wilaya`: list all its communes. Default false.

query.description: Free search across all communes, Arabic or Latin spelling.

wilaya.description: Wilaya code (1-69) or name in Arabic or Latin — "16", "الجزائر", "Alger".
